messages:
maya: Heads-up — launching webinar promo Friday 9AM PT. Planning a 48h paid burst. Need search + retarget creative refresh and pacing. Target CPL $45. Thoughts?
sam: Love it. Geo? landing page? any mandatory CTAs?
maya: US + CA, prioritize CA, NY, TX, WA, IL. Landing page is the webinar LP v3 (drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/webinar-lp-v3). CTAs: Register and Watch on-demand.
jess: Budget thought: $6k total — $3.5k search, $2k retarget, $500 experiments (creatives/placements). Pacing: frontload ~60% in first 12h to catch top-of-funnel, then steady. If CPL > $60 after 18h, throttle.
liam: For search: recommend max CPC $3.20, use broad+phrase combo, RSAs with new headlines. Bids by device: mobile -10%, desktop baseline. Use sitelink for webinar agenda.
liam: campaign settings (quick copy):
```
campaign: webinar_burst_mar24
budget_daily: 3000
bidding: manual_cpc
max_cpc: 3.2
keywords: +developer +llm +inference "model serving"
ads: RSA x3, ETA fallback
```
jess: We'll also run a lightweight creative A/B: hero image A (product screenshot) vs B (team photo). utm_content to differentiate.
ads-bot: daily-sync: last webinar burst avg CPC $2.85, CVR 1.6%, avg CPL $39 — historical baseline attached. (report: https://ads.redwood.ai/reports/last-burst) :bar_chart:
olivia: SDR routing — confirm we want inbound leads to go to the queue inbound-webinar, assign high intent if utm_content contains "register" and session_length > 30s. I can wire Zapier -> HubSpot.
maya: Yes. Mapping: name,email,company,role,utm_source,utm_medium,utm_campaign,utm_content. Tag leads as webinar-mar24-burst. Exclude internal emails.
sam: Tracking note: GA4 and server-side event required. Please append utm params like: ?utm_source=paid&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_burst&utm_content=creativeA
liam: Retargeting: 30d window, exclude converters last 7d, frequency cap 4/day. Creatives: 3 retarget cards — reminder, social proof, quick FAQ. Use dynamic templates for product screenshots.
jess: Also run a tiny lookalike seed from our last webinar converters (~2k users). Start at 1% and expand if CPA holds.
olivia: SDR rota: I'll add weekend coverage Sat-Sun 9am-3pm PT since frontload hits. Will send rota link in a sec.
maya: I'll update the campaign sheet with final budgets, creative links, and the ad manager upload CSV by EOD. Ping me for approvals.
sam: Can someone QA the LP variant gating for mobile? Last time mobile form hid CTA. If it's broken we'll kill mobile bid.
maya: Noted — @liam can you add a quick QA pass?
liam: On it. I'll run the smoke check and share logs.
jess: One more — add a tiny budget reserve for top-performing queries mid-burst so we can scale winners quickly (~$500).
maya: Good call. I'll mark $500 as scaling buffer.
ads-bot: scheduled reminder: upload final creatives by 18:00 today or campaigns will default to assets A only.
olivia: Got it — I'll confirm SDR mapping after I see the form fields.
maya: Thanks everyone — will post final sheet link when done. :white_check_mark:
